children: *Electrolux: Expect Volume, Price, Mix to Have Neutral Oper Income Contribution
Electrolux Swings to Net Loss, Dims Full-Year Outlook
Electrolux swung to a loss in the third quarter and dimmed its profit outlook for the year, citing higher raw material costs and tariffs.

The Swedish home-appliance manufacturer reported a net loss of 340 million Swedish kronor in the third quarter, equivalent to $34.3 million. In the year-prior period, it booked net profit of 192 million kronor.

Electrolux booked operating income of 607 million Swedish kronor in the third quarter, down from 890 million kronor in the same period a year prior. However, it surpassed analyst estimates of 542 million kronor, according to consensus estimates provided by the company.

Excluding non-recurring items, its operating income was hit by higher raw material and logistics costs due to conflict in the Middle East and U.S. tariff costs, it said. A recovery claim for overpaid tax lifted its overall operating income figure, it said.

The company said it now expects the combination of volume, price and mix to have a neutral contribution to operating income for the full year, while it previously expected a positive contribution. It cited a challenging market environment.
Sales rose 3.5% organically to 33.92 billion kronor, while company-compiled analyst expectations had seen the figure at 33.49 billion kronor.
